data.one_liner: Provides a large app bar that fades smoothly on scroll.
data.what_it_does: The package offers a customizable AppBar that expands and fades as the user scrolls. It works with a ScrollController and lets you define foreground, background, and bottom widgets.
use_when: You need a tall, collapsible AppBar with a fade‑out effect
You want a quick, plug‑and‑play solution without writing custom scroll logic
avoid_when: A simple static AppBar is sufficient
You require complex animations beyond fading
strengths: Easy to integrate with existing ScrollViews
Smooth fade animation out of the box
weaknesses: Relies on a ScrollController, adding boilerplate
